title: Practical AI Engineering and Business Automation

weeks.title: AI Foundations and Useful Work
weeks.summary: Choose a worthwhile task and measure the process before changing it.
outcomes: Distinguish models, assistants, workflows, and agents
Record a manual quality and time baseline

weeks.title: Prompting, Context, and Research
weeks.summary: Turn vague requests into verifiable briefs and check the evidence behind answers.
outcomes: Write a task and evidence contract

weeks.title: Data, Documents, and Media
weeks.summary: Check calculations and preserve source evidence when working with files and recordings.
outcomes: Extract fields without inventing missing values

weeks.title: AI-Assisted Engineering
weeks.summary: Deliver a small software change with requirements, review, tests, and rollback.
outcomes: Give a coding agent repository context
Review a change against acceptance criteria
Demonstrate a regression test and reversal

weeks.title: Model APIs and Structured Outputs
weeks.summary: Build validated interfaces and handle incomplete, refused, and incorrect responses.

weeks.title: Private Knowledge and Retrieval
weeks.summary: Answer from the right version of authorised documents and abstain without evidence.

weeks.title: Business Workflow Automation
weeks.summary: Use durable states, approvals, and idempotent effects to make workflows recoverable.
outcomes: Bind approval to an exact action

weeks.title: Agents, Tools, MCP, and Memory
weeks.summary: Give agents useful tools with enforced boundaries and observable execution.
outcomes: Explain an agent loop and MCP roles

weeks.title: OpenClaw in Practice
weeks.summary: Operate a restricted assistant through a test messaging channel.

weeks.title: Hermes Agent in Practice
weeks.summary: Teach a reusable procedure and verify what persists across sessions.
outcomes: Compare a fresh-session run with a baseline

weeks.title: Grok Bot and Platform Comparison
weeks.summary: Delegate a cloud task and compare complete systems on identical cases.
outcomes: Configure a bounded Bot and routine

weeks.title: Evaluation, Security, and Governance
weeks.summary: Use independent cases and failure evidence to make a release decision.

weeks.title: Deployment, Economics, and Adoption
weeks.summary: Prepare a monitored pilot with ownership, a recovery path, and an honest business case.
outcomes: Define operational metrics and stop conditions
Train an operator and rehearse recovery

weeks.title: Capstone: Implement
weeks.summary: Complete one narrow end-to-end system and freeze acceptance criteria.
outcomes: Agree a scope and interface contract

weeks.title: Capstone: Pilot and Improve
weeks.summary: Observe real or clearly simulated use, fix failures, and compare with the baseline.
outcomes: Classify and fix the most consequential failure

weeks.title: Capstone: Demonstrate and Hand Over
weeks.summary: Demonstrate success, failure, blocked action, and recovery, then defend the adoption decision.
outcomes: Choose adopt, revise, or stop from evidence
